patterns.name: Unrestricted Mint Function
patterns.description: Mint function without proper access control or supply cap
patterns.recommendation: Restrict mint to authorized callers and add supply cap

patterns.name: Admin Can Pause Contract
patterns.description: Admin can pause all contract operations, freezing user funds
patterns.recommendation: Add timelock or multi-sig for pause operations

patterns.name: Drain Function
patterns.description: Admin can withdraw all funds from the contract
patterns.recommendation: Remove arbitrary fund withdrawal or add governance approval

patterns.name: Mutable Fee Configuration
patterns.description: Admin can change fees to any value
patterns.recommendation: Add maximum fee cap enforced in the setter

patterns.name: Hidden Transfer in Logic
patterns.description: Token transfer to admin/dev embedded in regular operations
patterns.recommendation: Make all fee recipients transparent and immutable

patterns.name: Upgradeable Without Timelock
patterns.description: Contract upgrade function without governance delay
patterns.recommendation: Add timelock and governance approval for upgrades

patterns.name: Library Call to Mutable Address
patterns.description: Library call with admin-controlled class hash
patterns.recommendation: Ensure target addresses are immutable or governed by timelock

patterns.name: Hidden Owner Change
patterns.description: Owner/admin can be changed without event emission or timelock
patterns.recommendation: Emit events on ownership changes and add timelock

patterns.name: Replace Class Hash
patterns.description: Contract class can be replaced by admin, changing all logic
patterns.recommendation: Use governance with timelock for class hash replacement

patterns.name: Multiple Admin Roles
patterns.description: Contract has multiple privileged roles without clear documentation
patterns.recommendation: Document all admin roles and use multi-sig governance

patterns.name: Missing Caller Validation
patterns.description: External function doesn't validate the caller address
patterns.recommendation: Validate caller identity in all state-changing functions

patterns.name: Reentrancy via External Call
patterns.description: State changes after external contract call
patterns.recommendation: Update state before making external calls

patterns.name: Unprotected Initializer
patterns.description: Contract initializer can be called multiple times
patterns.recommendation: Add initialization guard to prevent re-initialization
